onboarding.title: Set up Lara
onboarding.text: I can build for you! For that I need a key from an AI provider, for example Anthropic.
onboarding.costs: Lara uses your own account with the provider. They bill you directly.
onboarding.data: What you write and your build go to the provider you choose. Nowhere else.
onboarding.key: Your key stays on this device.

settings.title: Set up Lara
settings.intro: Lara talks directly to the AI provider you choose here. You need an account and an API key there.
settings.anthropicHint: Lara's build tools work best here. Get a key at console.anthropic.com.
settings.openaiHint: OpenAI, OpenRouter, Azure or your own server (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM).
settings.modelHintOpenai: The provider's model name, e.g. gpt-… or llama3.1.
settings.baseUrlHint: The API address, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1 or http://localhost:11434/v1.
settings.apiKeyHint: Usually starts with “sk-”. Never stored in builds or exports.
settings.apiKeyStored: A key is stored. Leave empty to keep it.
settings.rememberWarning: The key is then stored unencrypted in the browser. Only do this on your own device.
settings.sessionOnly: Without the tick the key only lasts until you close the tab.
settings.nativeStorage: The key is kept in your device's secure storage (keychain).
settings.limitHint: Optional. Lara pauses when it is reached. Used today: {{ used }} tokens.

errors.baseUrl: Please enter an address starting with https:// or http://.
errors.limit: Please enter a whole number above 0, or leave it empty.

notes.title: Good to know
notes.costs: Every message to Lara costs a few tokens at the provider. You pay for them through your account there. Each answer shows how many it used.
notes.privacy: Your messages and your build go directly to the chosen provider. laracraft has no server of its own and sees none of it.
notes.storage: The key stays on this device. It never ends up in build files, exports or logs.
notes.age: Your provider's terms of use apply, including the minimum age. If unsure, ask your parents.
notes.local: Local servers like Ollama or LM Studio must allow requests from the browser (CORS).

settings.previewBlocked: In this preview Lara cannot reach an AI provider – the browser blocks the connection. Open the app directly (web version or app) and your key will work.
